FUTURE DIRECTION

Municipal dashboard

PULSE is currently a citizen-facing MVP. There is no government or municipal partnership in place.

In the future, authorized city teams could use aggregated, privacy-aware signals to understand trends, prioritize issues, and share verified updates with residents.
